cleaningkit

R package that cleans and validates Mixed Migration Centre 4Mi survey data (KoboToolbox exports): validate_*() checks produce cleaning logs, reviewers fill them in Excel, apply_cleaning_log() applies them. Sister package: analysiskit (DesktopKit) consumes the cleaned data.

Environment

  • Windows. Rscript is not on PATH; call it as "/c/Program Files/R/R-4.6.1/bin/Rscript.exe" from Bash.
  • Some features drive Excel through COM (RDCOMClient, MMC fork iAthmanMMC/RDCOMClient). They need Excel installed; don’t try to run them in a headless check.

Dev loop

  • Full cycle: Rscript dev/setup.R (attachment updates DESCRIPTION Imports, then devtools::document(), then devtools::check(vignettes = FALSE)).
  • Quick: Rscript -e "devtools::document()" and Rscript -e "devtools::test(filter = 'other_db')" (filter = test file stem).
  • Tests: testthat 3e in tests/testthat/. Add or update a test with any behaviour change; use withr for temp files and options.

Generated files: do not edit by hand

A PreToolUse hook blocks these; edit the source instead.

Generated Source Rebuild
man/*.Rd, NAMESPACE roxygen #' comments in R/ devtools::document()
README.md README.Rmd devtools::build_readme()
docs/ everything (pkgdown) pkgdown::build_site(); CI also builds it
inst/extdata/cleaningkit_vba.bin inst/vba/Module1.bas, ThisWorkbook.cls dev/build_vba_bin.R in Excel; ask the user, see inst/vba/README.md

Any change to inst/vba/*.bas|*.cls means the .bin must be rebuilt by the user; say so explicitly.

Conventions

  • Formatting: a PostToolUse hook runs air format on each .R file Claude edits. Don’t fight it.
  • Pipes: this package uses magrittr %>%; keep it consistent within a file.
  • Errors with base stop() (no cli/rlang); console colour with crayon.
  • Exported helpers that expose defaults are prefixed ck_ (e.g. ck_flag_column_names()); internal helpers are .dot_prefixed and tagged @keywords internal or @noRd.
  • Always call other packages with pkg::fn(); new dependencies get picked up by attachment in dev/setup.R.
  • 4Mi specifics: question codes like Q47, “other” choice codes such as 197/297, None = 996. Don’t hard-code a new question set without a ck_*() default the user can override.

Versioning and NEWS

  • CalVer in DESCRIPTION: YYYY.MM.patch (e.g. 2026.08.0).
  • Every user-visible change gets a NEWS.md entry under # cleaningkit (development version): a ## heading per theme, bullets that lead with the bolded function and explain the behaviour and why, in plain prose. Mark bug fixes with “Fixed:”.

Data

Survey data is personal data about people on the move. Never commit real datasets, cleaning logs or exports; scratch outputs go in Claude outputs/ (git-ignored). Use the example scripts in inst/examples/ as the reference workflow.
